integration.dispatch: In decode_bspline, dispatch intcurve-curve with subtype_start at token 4 and spring_int_cur at token 5 before the generic false-wrapper check. Existing readers remain unchanged.
integration.returns: Canonical XYZ degree/knots/controls/weights/domain, separate embedded UV cache, raw support/trailer/flags.
integration.evaluation: decode_bspline.evaluate_curve(cache, raw_cache_parameter). Edge parameter sign mapping is evidence-only, never silently applied.

framing.wrapper: Boolean true/false; spring_int_cur version 23100 enum 0; cubic form 0 rational XYZ grid; counted compact knots and four-value controls.
framing.support: Spline/ref0 with exact bounded false flags; explicit planar origin/normal/axis; degree 1 form 0 two-control non-rational UV grid.
framing.trailer: nullbs; two false flags; four empty scalar lists; observed terminal enum 0 (true wrapper) / 2 (false wrapper); outer subtype end and two false flags.
framing.unknowns: Wrapper/enum meaning, inline ref0 identity, cache scalar meaning and exact spring construction remain unresolved.

guards.reason: Spring NURBS weights must be finite and positive
Compact knot values are not strictly increasing

guards.guard: Trailing token after exact outer wrapper

limitations: Caches are stored approximations; finite sampled agreement provides no exact procedural equivalence or global error bound.
Direct API truth contains Fillet settings, not curve/surface evaluator outputs.
True wrapper examples have negative edge parameters and only sign-negated endpoint hypotheses fit the raw XYZ cache; this is not generalized into a production orientation rule.
The spline inline ref0 remains opaque. Surface 10 correspondence is independently established through typed coedge/loop/face links.
Raw ASM coordinates are retained; component/body transforms, unit/context conversions and lifecycle classification are not applied.

stored_embedded_uv_cache.scope: Independent stored UV grid; inline support identity/parameter correspondence not inferred

cache.flag_scope: Captured wrapper/enum pairs retained; no automatic edge-parameter negation, orientation or geometric reversal
cache.reference_scope: Inline ref0 is opaque; parent-surface correspondence requires independent coedge/loop/face links
cache.representation: Stored cubic rational spring-curve approximation with a separate linear UV cache; procedural spring definition is not reconstructed
cache.cache_status: Only stored grids/typed endpoint evidence; no direct API curve evaluator or global approximation error bound
cache.coordinate_scope: Raw ASM cache coordinates; body transforms and units/context not applied

curves.parameter_scope: Sign hypotheses are limited to these explicit endpoint links. Raw cache domain and wrapper are preserved; no general edge evaluator/reversal rule is added.
curves.comparison_scope: Each stored domain is sampled independently at equal fractions; tiny domain endpoint differences are retained. Finite agreement is internal cache corroboration, not exact procedural/API evaluator equivalence or a global error bound.
